text:
Keiko: quick post-RFC sync. I'm proposing a tiny probe-first handshake shim as the canonical handoff surface between Hosted/Dedicated/Private. objectives: reduce duplicated translation logic, shorten rollback window, and make capability negotiation explicit. shim only: health/probe, capability manifest exchange, routing hints, and transparent trace/req-id passthrough. no local secrets or state.

Sam: +1 direction. two sticky points we must model: (1) private HSM header injection and contractual operator flows, (2) streaming parity (chunk framing + backpressure).

Keiko: for HSM we keep operator-side injection (helm + operator manifest). shim will include an allowlist header so operator-side injector can act. for hosted/dedicated we route secret exchange to a short-lived token authorizer service; shim never touches key material.

Ibrahim: streaming parity approach: capture golden traces from production (framed chunks + boundaries). replay them through legacy facade and shim implementation; run a binary diff on chunk frames. failures -> automatic regression alert and fail-canary. need a small tool in harness to do this.

Dana: ops note: rollout must be reversible at LB level. propose these levels:
- alpha: internal hosted only (ff on)
- canary: hosted public with 2-week telemetry baseline
- opt-in: Dedicated tenants (exclude HSM-bound customers)
- private: operator install + tenant migration window
- GA: flip default after 12w stable
Also: LB kill-switch and automated rollback playbook (runbook + scripts).

Keiko: agreed. telemetry must be preserved. headers: traceparent, X-RW-Request-Id, x-rw-route-hint. shim adds x-rw-shim-probe during canaries; remove before GA.

Sam: compatibility: handshake returns a tiny JSON manifest with capability names and versions (e.g., "kv_layout:v4","streaming:chunked-v2"). shim refuses to route to runtimes lacking required capabilities and will either 1) route to legacy facade, or 2) return 409 with a migration hint. Add an automatic discovery job to catalog runtime capabilities.

Ibrahim: KV cache concerns: in-flight cache pointers across a runtime change are risky. mitigation: maintain legacy facade for tenant until reconciliation job migrates KV indexes. snapshot KV state pre-flip and have background reconciler that does pointer remap. ops must certify snapshot success before flip.

Dana: CI and manifest drift: add an infra-lint rule that flags deprecated facade-only fields and a Dedicated preflight gate for provisioning that warns if tenant config references facade features. Also surface a migration note in the provisioning UI.

ops-bot: scheduled job: handoff-baseline-182600 (cadence=daily, retention=14d). snapshot job created: handoff-snapshot-182600 (retention=30d). link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/handoff/182600

Keiko: parity measurement plan: three routes (chat-short, chat-long-8k, embeddings) at three traffic buckets (100, 500, 1500 tps). Collect P50/P95/P99, error classes, token-cost-per-request, and streaming-latency-by-chunk. regression gates: <=2.5% p95 delta, no new 5xx codes, streaming chunk diff == 0.

Sam: add quality regressions: 2k sampled prompts against deterministic routes (token-for-token) and nondeterministic route similarity (BLEU/embedding sim thresholds). include tokenization id sequence checks when available.

Ibrahim: security ops: operator-install docs must be reviewed by security (HSM patterns). tag @security-team in the PR.

Keiko: timeline suggestion: prototype (7d) -> harness + binary streaming diff (5d) -> hosted alpha (2w) -> hosted canary (2w) -> dedicated opt-ins (3w) -> private operator migration docs (2w) -> GA flip after 12w. keep canaries long for streaming-heavy tenants.

Dana: ops OK. I'll own LB kill-switch and snapshot verification. please add me to PRs.

merge-bot: PR #5011 opened: "probe-shim: handshake + initial harness" - https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/5011

Sam: I'll review the PR and the harness results. Keiko: please include exact prometheus queries and a dashboard template for parity comparison in the rollout doc.

Keiko: will do. I'll draft the rollout playbook, the manifest-lint spec, operator helm snippet for private installs, and the streaming-diff tool README. pinging this thread for reviews when ready. thanks all. :handshake:
